scientific_integrity: Exact proof from graph incidence determinants and determinant multiaffinity, supported by bounded independent integer enumeration. No independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The 1995 determinant theorem already covers all vertex-supported determinant values. New work only claims the unrestricted optimizer rigidity phase, constructed positive-dimensional families, and maximizer graph census, not a complete classification of every flexible maximizing simplex. Historical priority provisional; independent audit not performed.
title: Residue-three rigidity and movable maximum-volume simplices in second hypersimplices
